assumptions: The EUR 50 ceiling is a conservative gross experiment-spend cap and does not assume educational credits or discounts.
Each remaining measured run reserves 15 minutes, except G1 which reserves 20 minutes for passive-region activation.
The 600-event payload and one-second probes add negligible data-volume charges relative to compute and fixed service meters.
Fixed remaining allocations conservatively retain setup/transition, one warm-up for each of F1/G1/G2, teardown and a reserve for omitted ancillary meters.
Completed E1 consumption is excluded from this remaining estimate and retained separately; actual billed E1 cost remains pending Azure Cost Management delay.
The future repeat reduction responds to observed operational duration/resource overhead, not to the numerical E1 outcome.
Resources are deleted or stopped promptly outside the planned windows.
price_sources: Azure Retail Prices API queried 2026-08-29 in EUR; Italy North and Norway East amended meters queried 2026-08-30: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices
scope: remaining_post-E1 Azure execution under protocol v1.0.8
